title: NJ News Hub → Instagram Post
description:
Pick an article from njnewshub.com and generate an Instagram-ready caption plus a 1080×1080 image from the article photo.

**How to use**
1. Leave Article URL empty to auto-pick from the homepage, or paste a specific njnewshub.com story URL.
2. Tune the caption (key points, hashtags, length).
3. Choose whether to generate a square Instagram image and how text should appear on it.

Results are saved to the dataset and key-value store (`OUTPUT` + `instagram-<slug>.png`).

articleUrl.title: Article URL
articleUrl.description:
Full URL of a njnewshub.com article to turn into an Instagram post.

Examples:
- `https://njnewshub.com/bayonne/hudson-county-community-market-bayonne-food-pantry`
- `https://njnewshub.com/new-jersey/mare-french-bistro-spring-lake`

Leave empty to auto-pick a story from the homepage using the selection below.
articleUrl.sectionDescription: Choose a specific story, or leave the URL empty and let the Actor pick one from njnewshub.com.

selection.title: Auto-pick mode
selection.description:
Used only when Article URL is empty.

- **Featured** — homepage top/hero story
- **Latest** — first story from the Latest section
- **Random** — random story currently shown on the homepage

includeKeyPoints.title: Include key points
includeKeyPoints.description: Add the article’s key points as bullet lines (•) in the Instagram caption.
includeKeyPoints.sectionDescription: Control what goes into the Instagram caption text.

maxCaptionLength.title: Max caption length
maxCaptionLength.description: Soft character limit for the finished caption. Hashtags are kept; the body is truncated near this length if needed. Instagram allows up to about 2,200 characters.

extraHashtags.title: Extra hashtags
extraHashtags.description: Hashtags always appended to the caption (with or without `#`). Article keywords, city, and category are added automatically on top of these.

includeArticleLink.title: Include article link
includeArticleLink.description: Append a “Read more: …” line with the njnewshub.com article URL.

ctaText.title: Call-to-action line
ctaText.description: Short line shown near the end of the caption (before hashtags). Leave empty to omit.

generateImage.title: Generate Instagram image
generateImage.description: Download the article picture and compose a 1080×1080 PNG saved to the key-value store as `instagram-<slug>.png`.
generateImage.sectionDescription: Build a square post image from the article’s photo.

imageStyle.title: Image style
imageStyle.description:
How headline text is placed on the article image.

- **Bottom gradient** — headline over a dark fade at the bottom (best default)
- **Full overlay** — centered headline on a darkened full-bleed image
- **Image only** — cropped square photo with no text overlay

brandLabel.title: Brand label on image
brandLabel.description: Small brand line drawn at the bottom of the generated image (e.g. NJ NEWS HUB). Ignored when Image style is “Image only”.
